items.note: N1 states the signed exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) in three stages with every scratch wire restored, but never gives the index set (triples of [100]), the neighbour rules or the gate maps. The route (cancel the old scratch values, copy/gather, scatter/inject, undo, then forward-inverse-forward) is the paper's, but the coefficient check (|S∩T| mod 2, or (|S∩T|-1)/2, cancelled by the side wires) appears only as 'intersection-size coefficients so that the unwanted ones cancel'.

N2 states D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, endpoint-only dependence and D_vD_u^{-1} on edges. It derives these by the paper's invariant (stored = frame applied to logical) and the commuting of a common frame with a pointwise linear gate.

Comparable nondegenerate labels in F^{⊗3}, the only decrease being center 3->4 losing h, and L_b/N=100/539, L_c/N=101/539 are stated. L=Ich and the budget Σ|Δdim|=Wm-2N+2L are not; the plan says only 'below W·m'. The derivation lacks the orthogonality of neighbouring triple lines that makes the side-wire inclusions possible, and the telescoping count (source dims N, sink dims Wm-N).

The XOR network, projection matrices with -P_{U_a} at X_a sources, the endpoint identity = I_m, the shear H<-H+D on every role, and s_b<W_bm with deficit N-2L_b are all stated. The derivation gives 'rank = dimension change' and the endpoint computation, but omits the exceptional first edge on X_a (matrix 2P_{U_a}, rank one where the dimension change is zero) that turns -2N into -N.

Kernels aI+bX_v per orthonormal residual vector, s_c<W_cm, and C^{⊗m} on every role are stated. However, the frame is given as the bare phase i^{wt(P_Ux) mod 4}, without the Hadamard conjugation, and s_c=W_cm-2N+2L_c is missing. The route (weight additivity mod 4, odd weight, telescoping, C=iZC^{-1}Z on the 27 coordinates, undoing the sign) is the paper's, but the step where H sends the character (-1)^{v·x} to the translation X_v is absent.

Several steps state L<N/2, s<Wm, deficits above 20·2^{-50} and τ=1-2^{-50} (σ only in A1.1). The exact η values and the condition log m<20 that gives m^τ>m(1-η) are missing. N6 is a quote-only inference with no method for the exponent inequality.

The streaming operations and their methods match the paper's proofs: aligned streams after a digit split, cut-and-remerge rotation, and increasing pieces for unit multiplication. T2 drops the hypothesis that the offset be preparable in b^{O(1)} time, and the prime/denominator conditions.

The factorization A=E_1ΠE_2 (topmost row, rightmost pivot, lower triangular elimination) and the shear with exactly a interchanges plus O(V) are stated. The derivation follows the paper: triangular factors as controlled shifts, and each pivot as shift-interchange-shift.

Every step of the paper's proof is present: cyclic row split into W role streams, Φ_{A_e} per edge via recursive interchanges, H<-H+D on every row, the three-shear interchange, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) solved to O(e^τ), and the fixed-tape parking schedule at O(V) per node.
Stated with the address permutation and O(Vu^τ), and derived by the paper's route: top ρ digits as rows, padding to W^k, base-m pieces as a geometric sum, and padding binary ranges to [q^e].

Slots of f chunks, conjugation by P_M, inverse children via (C^{-1})^{⊗f}=(-i)^f Z C Z, exactly s_c children on f=e/m axes, and H_0^{⊗D}=b^D S_D C^{⊗D} S_D are all present. L1's phrase 'each of the s_c residual-basis slots' blurs the per-edge ρ_edge slots with the network total s_c.

The derivation follows the paper closely: the eight rotations as two 3-cycles, one cyclic shift per line, the guard interval [10,2^{K-1}-11], the union bound giving 80(f-1)2^{-K}, bijections agreeing off B, radix-sort repair, and the two-bit XOR for the top position. The time is given only as O(V(L^τ+1)) 'plus negligible repair terms', without the MA^3 and δ_bad terms or the family hypotheses that make them negligible.

The node overhead O(V((eK)^τ+1)), s children of volume V/W, rows from the first q_0 chunks and F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^τ+1) are stated. The leaves F(e)=O(e) for e<d^β, their O(e^σ d^{β(1-σ)}) contribution, K<=e^{c/β}, and the condition λ'>max{λ,σ+β(1-σ)} are missing. L2.3 claims that the whole recurrence sums to O(e^λ).

Stated as one simultaneous H_0 layer on D<=d chunks in O(Vd^{λ'}), exact up to one truncation, with guard width Δ=⌈C_0d^{C_1}⌉ from A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E. Derived by the paper's route: the H_0-to-C identity, phase-frame recursion on split rows, the guard bits, and the row-sum-one disk bound with error <√2·2^{-p}.

Character cancellation by shifting k, the DIF recursion, the bit-reversed stored order and its reverse consumption, prefix slots, chunk exchanges, one layer per round, the monomial split, and truncation commuting with J_E all match the paper, as do the cost and error bounds.

Evaluation at B_0=2^{4p}, four products by the established multiplier, centered residues with |h_j|<B_0/2, and negacyclic reduction follow the proof. The statement omits that the returned value is Q_p(fg/r), normalized by r.

The error √2M(3ℓ+1)2^{-p} and the cost are stated. The retained LB order (the pointwise product commutes with the record permutation), the opposite transform, the exact scale by M and the 3δ+η error are all present; the explicit normalization identity is left implicit in 'scale exactly by M'.

The identity P_sF_s=2^{2α^2}B_0P_tF_tA, its tensor form, and the error, time and movement bounds are stated. The permutations P_s, P_t ((P_su)_j=u_{tj}, (P_tv)_k=v_{-sk}) and γ=2dα^2 are never defined. The derivation follows the paper: S, T, C, D, ‖N-I‖<1/2, the left inverse D N^{-1} C, HvdH's ordered maps, linewise expansion and compression, and chunk-swap axis exposure.

Both identities are stated exactly. The proofs (coefficient comparison with period t_i; the dilation substitution giving R F^+ R = F^+, the pointwise product and the normalized convolution rule) match the paper, and conjugation gives RF^+_s.

The exponents, the sizes b, p, d, K, T, the prime window, the n^{o(1)} search and T/2<S<T are stated; η=1/(4d) and r are not given. The check α^4θ_i>3db>=p that the resampling hypothesis actually requires is missing: the plan says only 'separation t_i/s_i-1>η needed by Gaussian resampling'.

Φ with μ_i=P_i^{-1} mod s_i is stated as an isomorphism preserving cyclic convolution, with cost O(Tpd^2(1+ℓ^τ)). The paper's steps are present: algebra map, reorder axes, update targets from i=d down, prefix-controlled cyclic shifts, O(d^2) chunk interchanges. The triangular formula itself appears only in words.
The twist x_d->ζy, its well-definedness, the diagonal invertibility and the wrap factor ζ^{k+l}(-1)^h=ζ^j match the paper. The computed twist/convolve/untwist with 2·2^{-p} phase errors is in A6.1.

The source transform (A, chirp, B_0, 2^γ) with exact counterpart RF_s, the conjugate opposite procedure, the step order (Φ, two transforms, product, opposite, scales S and 2^{2b+4}S, rounding, Φ^{-1}, carries) and the role of the two S factors all match the paper.

The error chain is present: contraction and bilinear propagation, chirp <8TL, E_s=9·2^γTL, the (3E_s+2) step after cancellation, the final 448b2^{-b+γ}<=448b2^{-3b/4}<1/2, and carries below Q_0^2 with the invariant. E_w<28·2^γT^2L is not written but is subsumed by E4.

V=Tp, seven dominant powers at most 1-2κ, κ=2^{-182}, log-power absorption and the schoolbook cutoff are stated correctly. The table's terms appear only scattered in H, I2 and A4, and the margin formulas g_1..g_7 (in particular g_2=εc(1-τ) for the layout chunk exchanges) are never given; only the value 2^{-181} is.
Only the label 'nlogn-conjecture' in R's relies-on. No step states the eventual-lower-bound formulation or why a liminf of zero refutes it.

errors.says: A target update y->y+a(controls) mod Q with controls earlier on tape costs O(V), as does multiplication by a fixed rational unit.
errors.paper: The O(V) bound holds only if the offset can be prepared in b^{O(1)} time from the fixed number of control values, with denominators (and unit numerators) prime to q (lines 557-568).

errors.says: The Gaussian-dyadic network uses phase frames i^{wt(P_Ux) mod 4}.
errors.paper: The frame is C_U=H^{⊗m} diag_x(i^{q_U(x)}) H^{⊗m} (line 1193). The Hadamard conjugation is what turns the diagonal character into the translation X_v, so the bare phase cannot yield the kernels aI+bX_v (lines 1254-1257).

errors.says: Apply the f-fold forward child on each of the s_c residual-basis slots.
errors.paper: For each edge, after conjugation by P_M, one child is applied on slot h for each 1<=h<=ρ_edge; there are only m slots, and s_c counts the children summed over all edges of the network (lines 1878-1882, 1904-1906).

errors.says: With a=s/W<m^λ, the recurrence F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^τ+1) sums to O(e^λ).
errors.paper: Only the internal costs sum to O(e^λ), using K<=e^{c/β}, τ(1+c/β)<λ and a<=m^σ<m^λ. The leaves (F(e)=O(e) for e<d^β) add O(e^σ d^{β(1-σ)}), which is why λ'>max{λ,σ+β(1-σ)} is needed (lines 2413-2444).

chain: The tree follows the paper's route to the main bound. Its first branch runs from the scalar exchange network, frames and subspace labels to the bit and complex interfaces and the exponent τ. That feeds two branches: the matrix shear and the power-width and arbitrary-width interchange, and the phase-frame layer with packed row additions and guard widths. From there the tree goes to synthetic transforms and convolution, resampling with chirp and permutation cancellation, the algorithm, exact recovery and the cost table. It thins out at the network's foundations: h, N and m are never defined, and the budget Wm-2N+2L with the rank-one source exceptions is only alluded to. It also thins out at the exponent step (log m<20), at the layer recurrence's leaf term, and at the cost margins, where only g_2=2^{-181} is given.

steps.note: The exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with every scratch wire restored is stated. But h=100, the indexing of the banks by triples in T^3, N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 are never given, although N, m and h are used later. Conservative: much of the defining content is missing.
A common invertible frame commutes with the pointwise gate, the network implements D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, and each edge applies D_vD_u^{-1}, so only endpoint frames matter.
Nondegenerate labels in the m-dimensional F^{⊗3}, every edge joining comparable labels, and the only decreasing edges being center 3->4 each losing h are all stated.

N4's method says edge differences are projections onto residuals whose rank is the dimension change, and N3 makes edge cost equal dimension change. The N rank-one exceptional source edges (2P_{U_a}) appear only as 'extra source ranks' in N3.2.

The plan gives the bit deficit N-2L_b (equivalent to s_b=W_bm-N+2L_b) but not the label budget Σ|Δdim|=Wm-2N+2L or L=Ich. N3 says only 'below W·m', and the source/sink dimension count behind -2N is absent.
L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539 below 1/2, the deficit N-2L_b>0 and s<Wm for both networks are all present.
M_sink(ρ(w))-M_source(w)=I_m for every role, computed as P_{U_a^⊥}+P_{U_a}=I_m for X_a, giving the shear H<-H+D on every row.
A=E_1ΠE_2 and exactly a interchanges plus O(V) per shear of rank a are stated; C1.1/C1.1.4 give s recursive calls per node in total.
Children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), deficits above 20·2^{-50} giving s/W<m^τ with τ=1-2^{-50}, and F_k=O(e^τ) are present. The bound log m<20 that links the deficits to τ is not stated.

central.summary: The plan carries most of the central chain. It has frames, labels, rank equal to dimension change, the 100/539 and 101/539 ratios giving s<Wm, the endpoint identity giving H<-H+D, shears costing their rank in recursive interchanges, and the recurrence with τ=1-2^{-50}. It is weakest at the start: the network's parameters (h=100, triples, N, m) are never defined, and the dimension budget Wm-2N+2L (with L=Ich) is replaced by its consequence, the deficit N-2L_b. 7 of 9 steps are reconstructed.
